item.title: Welcome to Data with Mehreen
item.dc:creator: Mehreen Ali Gillani
item.description:
I’m one month away from finishing my master’s in Data Science, and I’m starting Data with Mehreen to share what I learned in a practical, beginner-friendly way.

What to expect

  • One mini project every week: real dataset, real code, clear takeaways
  • Concept explainers: statistics and ML ideas in plain English
  • Lessons learned: the mistakes I made so you don’t have to

First up

What can a bakery’s sales data tell us about what people buy together? Next week I’ll use market basket analysis on the BreadBasket dataset to find out. 🥐☕

Follow along on GitHub and LinkedIn.
